social_circle.name: Rosa Jimenez

background.how_they_met: They met through family and church circles when they were young adults in Washington and married in the early 1970s.
background.why_close: Rosa is Pedro's main emotional partner, household teammate, and the person who notices when he is worried. They share Catholic faith, family routines, budgeting, cooking, and aging-in-place goals.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, practical texts with full sentences; often reminders, grocery notes, appointment details, and affectionate check-ins. Uses few emojis, maybe a heart or praying hands from time to time.

recent_text_topics: Grocery lists and reminders about medicine, especially Pedro's blood pressure pills and Rosa's diabetes needs.
Coordinating Friday errands, pharmacy pickups, church plans, and family birthdays.
Checking in when one of them is out of the house, especially because Pedro has cut back on night driving and Rosa dislikes being alone after dark.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Pedro says Rosa is his wife of a little over fifty years and 'the main person in my life.' Q11: they live together and share chores. Q18: Rosa catches him reaching for the salt shaker. Q47: they go to Mass most Sundays.

social_circle.name: Luis Jimenez

background.how_they_met: Luis is Pedro and Rosa's youngest adult son.
background.why_close: Luis lives closest, stops by often, helps with technology and taxes, and is a practical source of support without making Pedro feel dependent.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Clear, helpful texts with screenshots, links, and step-by-step explanations. Uses casual English, occasional Spanish family phrases, and light joking when Pedro asks for tech help.

recent_text_topics: Helping Pedro and Rosa understand tax forms and simple software reminders.
Coordinating a weekly stop by the house to check a printer, phone setting, or online account.
Sending family photos and confirming Sunday meal times or whether Pedro needs anything from the store.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Luis 'lives closer to Puyallup and works with computers,' and Luis stops by maybe once a week. Q75: Luis helped Pedro and Rosa use a simple tax program and check forms.

social_circle.name: Elena Jimenez

demographics.education: Some college and medical office certificate

background.how_they_met: Elena is Pedro and Rosa's adult daughter.
background.why_close: Pedro trusts Elena's health judgment because she works around medical offices, and she is one of the children who keeps family support moving through calls, food, rides, and appointments.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Efficient but warm texts, often in full sentences. She sends appointment reminders, health clarifications, and family updates, sometimes with photos from the grandchildren.

recent_text_topics: Vaccine, pharmacy, and doctor-office questions because Pedro trusts her medical-office experience.
Checking on Pedro's blood pressure numbers and Rosa's diabetes appointments.
Planning visits from Tacoma and coordinating grandchildren's schedules for Sunday meals or birthdays.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Elena lives in Tacoma and works in a medical office. Q42: Pedro asks Elena when he does not understand vaccine or health information. Q46: Elena seems stressed because medical office work wears her out and she still helps her children.

social_circle.name: Marco Jimenez

demographics.education: High school diploma with workplace supervisory training

background.how_they_met: Marco is Pedro and Rosa's adult son.
background.why_close: Marco shares Pedro's practical temperament and has a family history around work, race, and policing that Pedro still remembers. They connect around family, sports, and straightforward problem-solving.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, direct texts, often logistical. More likely to send short updates, sports comments, or a quick 'you need anything?' than long emotional messages.

shared_activities: Sunday dinners when his schedule allows
Talks about work and local issues
recent_text_topics: Whether Marco can make it to Sunday dinner or a family birthday around his warehouse schedule.
Seahawks or Mariners comments, especially during games or highlights.
Family discussions about policing, race, and how younger relatives talk about those issues.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Marco lives in Federal Way and does warehouse supervision. Q21: Marco was stopped and questioned by police as a teenager. Q26: Pedro talks about race and policing mostly with Rosa and his sons.

social_circle.name: Teresa Jimenez

demographics.occupation: Retired fruit packing worker and part-time church volunteer

background.how_they_met: Teresa is Pedro's younger sister; they grew up together in Yakima in a Spanish-speaking Mexican American household.
background.why_close: Pedro says Teresa is the sibling he is closest to. They share childhood memories, Spanish conversation, grief for their parents, and Yakima family history.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts less often than she calls, but sends warm Spanish-English messages, family updates, prayer requests, and old photos. Uses full sentences and affectionate terms like 'hermano'.

shared_activities: Occasional visits to Puyallup or Yakima
recent_text_topics: Checking on each other's health after Teresa's earlier heart scare and Pedro's blood pressure concerns.
Remembering their parents, old Yakima stories, and family recipes Pedro wants for his handwritten cookbook.
Coordinating Teresa's possible yearly visit to Puyallup and asking after Rosa, the children, and grandchildren.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06: Pedro has a younger sister Teresa in Yakima, says she is the sibling he is closest to, and says they talk by phone 'not every week.' Q35: Teresa had a heart scare. Q87: Pedro sometimes visits Yakima to see Teresa.
